name: send4
description: Build AI lead qualification flows, run SMS and email campaigns, and book meetings in your Send4 workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT or Codex to Send4 for AI lead qualification, automated follow-up and appointment booking. Describe how you want leads handled, and the assistant builds a Send4 flow that follows up by SMS or email, asks qualifying questions, answers customer questions and books meetings with your team.

Build: Say what you need to know before a sales call, such as budget, timing, location and requirements, and what should happen with each answer. The assistant builds your flow, lets you test it as a customer and checks it for issues before it goes live. Changes to a live flow are made on a draft copy.

Run: Launch SMS and email campaigns to existing leads, review conversations, reply yourself or hand the conversation back to Send4's AI. Book or reschedule meetings from the chat.

Improve: Ask about common customer questions and objections, where leads drop off and why conversations stop. Review campaign results, meeting bookings and plan usage in plain language.

Stay in control: Your workspace admin decides whether assistants can connect and what they may change. You choose permissions when connecting. Launching a campaign and switching a flow on need your confirmation. Every change is recorded in Send4's audit log as made through an AI assistant.

Requires a Send4 workspace on a paid plan or a trial with a card on file, with AI assistants switched on by an admin.
defaultPrompt: Build a Send4 flow for leads from my website's inquiry form: text them right away, ask their budget and timing, and book a call.
Rehearse my new Send4 flow as a customer and tell me what to fix before it goes live.
Where do leads drop off in my Send4 flows, and why?
